# GitHub Copilot Instructions

- Follow [README.md](../README.md) and [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
- Keep changes focused and covered by relevant tests.
- Prefer Hermes API/gateway adapters over direct imports from Hermes internals.
- Treat optional capabilities as discoverable at runtime.
- Update `docs/engineering-journal/` when a durable learning or decision appears.
- Do not commit secrets or private operational context.
